name: Holy Avenger
description: A longsword with a hilt of gold and a blade that gleams even in shadow.
body:
## What it does

Any sword can carry this blessing; this one is a longsword. It strikes far truer and harder than a plain sword, and it burns fiends and undead with holy light.

## Aura

While you hold it drawn, you and every friendly creature within 10 feet of you have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magic. The aura reaches 30 feet once you are a 17th-level paladin.

damage.note: against a fiend or an undead

advantages.name: Saving throws
advantages.note: against spells and other magical effects
